lines:
Semantic and source-of-truth design tables for Structurizr DSL and JSON, C4 rows, typed Mermaid UML artifacts, code bindings, and the common design-target index used by UI mockups. Internal resource versions permit disjoint changes to commit while overlapping updates or destructive dependency changes fail precisely. Implemented contract: expose a deterministic canonical editable snapshot for each independently editable design document and its server-computed hash readToken. Tokens cover the editable document content rather than unrelated project changes or derived presentation state. Comparison of the submitted token, validation of current references and dependencies, and persistence occur atomically. On mismatch no attempted changes are stored; return the complete current document and its matching token from one consistent snapshot. The project cursor remains a notification mechanism rather than a document precondition.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): First-class Markdown design documents complement C4, typed UML and SVG mockups. A MarkdownDesignDocument is an authored artefact distinct from the existing generic DesignDocument token envelope. Canonical fields are externalId, title, body (complete Markdown), and ordered typed designLinks; a stable externalId is independent of title and generated filename. No designLinks means project scope. Optional links associate it with existing elements, relationships, UML, mockups or other Markdown documents without making their lifetimes dependent. Retrieval never recursively expands document links without bounds. Documents may have direct file/symbol bindings and appear in scopes reached through linked architecture. Markdown uses target kind markdown everywhere. Task/QA references and backlinks use typed stable identity, never generated paths. Reject deletion while incoming references/bindings remain unless the same guarded transaction explicitly detaches/removes those references; never cascade-delete prose when an architecture element is deleted. Enforce project isolation, identity uniqueness and reference integrity. The selected Adashi storage backend owns the only authoritative content. Desktop humans edit through Adashi; agents author through MCP. Generated files are one-way read projections, not imported on open or watched as editable sources. An explicit import workflow can register existing prose and convert reviewed task references without destroying originals. No mandatory document approval lifecycle or new collaboration system.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.
